تلتقطين (form VIII)
# تَلْتَقِطِينَ (taltaqiṭīna) /tal.ta.qi.tˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# تُلْتَقَطِينَ (tultaqaṭīna) /tul.ta.qa.tˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
